title: A completed formal cover from liftable finite generating sections
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], $K$ a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, and $(F_n)_{n\geq1}$ a coherent formal module for $K$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Let $L$ be an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module] and $d\geq0$ an integer. Assume $H^1(X,\ker(F_{n+1}\to F_n)\otimes L^{\otimes d})=0$ for every $n\geq1$, with cohomology as in [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology] and tensor as in [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Suppose $F_1\otimes L^{\otimes d}$ has a specified finite family of generating global sections [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections]. Then there exist a coherent module $G$ [pqf-def-coherent] and a formal morphism $\alpha:G^\wedge\to(F_n)$ whose first component $G/KG\to F_1$ is epimorphic.

source.place: Lemma 0885 (lemma-existence-projective), first essential-surjectivity paragraph, from the chosen generating sections through the compatible maps and completed surjection

proof.text: The formal-system quotient condition makes every transition epimorphic. Tensoring by the invertible power L^d is an equivalence, so it preserves kernels and short exact sequences.

Apply the long exact sequence of derived global sections to each twisted transition. The assumed vanishing of H^1 of its kernel makes the global-section map surjective. Recursively choose lifts of each member of the given finite generating family; this gives compatible sections at every level.

Set P=L^d. Via the tensor-dual adjunction, each lifted section defines a map P dual to F_n. Take the finite direct sum G of these copies of P dual. It is coherent: its summands are locally free of rank one on a Noetherian scheme, and finite sums preserve coherence. The maps G to F_n commute with the transitions.

The annihilation condition K^(n+1)F_n=0 implies that G to F_n kills the ideal-product inclusion. The universal property of its cokernel produces a unique map G/K^(n+1)G to F_n. Uniqueness proves naturality, so these maps form a morphism alpha from completion(G) to F.

At the first level the map G to F_1 becomes the evaluation epimorphism of the given generating family after tensoring by P. Tensor equivalence reflects epimorphisms. Since G to F_1 factors through G/KG, its induced map G/KG to F_1 is epi as well.
